title: 017. Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
prompt: Given a string `s`, find the length of the longest substring without repeating characters.
steps: For `right, ch in enumerate(s)`: while `ch in seen`, remove `s[left]` and increment `left`
Add `ch` to `seen` and update `best = max(best, right - left + 1)`
pythonOutlineComments:
# Step 1: Initialize `seen = set()`, `left = 0`, `best = 0`

hints.title: Pattern & Invariant
hints.content: Core invariant: `Window [left..right] contains zero duplicate characters`

hints.title: Step-by-Step Plan
hints.content: Step 1: Initialize `seen = set()`, `left = 0`, `best = 0` -> Step 2: For `right, ch in enumerate(s)`: while `ch in seen`, remove `s[left]` and increment `left` -> Step 3: Add `ch` to `seen` and update `best = max(best, right - left + 1)`

hints.title: Complexity & Edge Cases
hints.content: Aim for O(N) time and O(min(N, M)) space. Watch empty inputs, single elements, and duplicates.
